en.title: Two documents, two jobs

items.text: Lets you travel and ask to enter

en.note: Visa-free? You may still need a travel authorisation
en.alt: Comparison diagram: a passport shows who you are and your nationality and is issued by your country; a visa lets you travel and ask to enter, is issued by the destination, and some cover several countries. The border officer decides. Visa-free trips may still need a travel authorisation
en.caption: Two documents, two jobs - and the border officer makes the final call.
